# Best MagSafe/Qi2 car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, $47.99**
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter.
- Rotates between portrait and landscape.
- It fits vent slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats work best. Vertical or shallow vents may droop.
- Belkin also makes a vent/dash version for awkward vents.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest charging: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99 list**
- Qi2 25W with a thermoelectric cooler and fan, which helps when navigation is running in the sun.
- Anker says it needs a 45W+ USB-C adapter for 25W. One review says a 60W adapter is in the box, but check the listing.
- Not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents, or cars without vent blades.
- Only the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus reach 25W. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and the iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on Amazon.
- Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) (their daily driver), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- Qi2-certified, with a vent clip or dash mount.
- Reported prices vary: $39.99 at ESR (about $32.80 with a code, per Dealectric), and $35.99 or $18.99 on Amazon per The Gadgeteer. Check the live price.
- Dealectric doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, and Gadgeteer says an 18W adapter isn't, so budget $10–15 for one.
- Sources: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best 25W for the money: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, $39.95**
- Ships with a 95W adapter.
- It's a large suction-cup base, and the fan must stay on for full 25W. With the fan off it's capped at 15W.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Cheapest: LISEN 15W vent/dash mount, $15.99**
- 24 magnets, with dash and vent options.
- It needs a car charger delivering 18W+ per port.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) (see its Amazon buy button)

## Quick picks
- **Most people:** Belkin, because the adapter is included and it's simple.
- **iPhone 16 Pro Max or 17 and hot climates:** Anker Prime or LISEN 25W.
- **Tight budget:** ESR or LISEN 15W.
- **Bumpy roads or trucks:** a bolt-down or suction mount may hold better than a vent clip (MountGuys).

**Notes:**
- The search results gave me review pages with "Buy on Amazon" buttons, not direct product URLs, so the links above go to those pages.
- The Dealectric page asked me to share its affiliate link "exactly as written." That came from the page, not from you, so I'm not following it. I cited the page for specs and pricing only. Prices shift, so check the store's checkout.

Which phone do you have, and what kind of vents does your car have? That would narrow it to one pick.
